title: Receive Service Request
text: Receive service request from ROS 2 network, 3 outputs; {Name} sets the service name character vector, {Type} sets the service type character vector, {Paired Send Response Block} sets the path to paired Send Service Response block block, {Sample time} sets the interval between outputs, {Show Default Response output port} enables default response output port, {History} sets the mode of storing requests in the queue Keep, {Depth} sets the size of the request queue, {Reliability} sets the delivery guarantee, {Durability} sets the persistence of requests, {Deadline} sets the maximum amount of time allowed between receiving a service request and sending response, {Lifespan} sets the length of time a service request is considered valid, {Liveliness} sets the level of liveliness reporting provided by the block and expected from service clients and {Lease Duration} sets the maximum amount of time before which a connected service client has to assert liveliness. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Paired Send Response Block
params.values: Path to paired Send Service Response block block path

params.name: Show Default Response output port
params.values: Enable default response output port on (default) | off

params.name: History
params.values: Mode of storing requests in the queue Keep last (default) | Keep all

params.name: Depth
params.values: Size of the request queue 1 (default) | non-negative scalar integer

params.name: Reliability
params.values: Delivery guarantee of requests Reliable (default) | Best effort

params.name: Durability
params.values: Persistence of requests Volatile (default) | Transient local

params.name: Deadline
params.values: Maximum amount of time allowed between receiving a service request and sending response Inf (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Lifespan
params.values: Length of time a service request is considered valid Inf (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Liveliness
params.values: Level of liveliness reporting provided by the block and expected from service clients automatic (default)

params.name: Lease Duration
params.values: Maximum amount of time before which a connected service client has to assert liveliness Inf (default) | positive scalar
